note: Gate file. Every thing in the game that can make a sound, mapped to its sound-list rows. tools/audio_check.py --events reads the sources below and fails when one of their events, states, attacks, features, screens, settings rows or menu actions has no key here, when a key names a sound that is not a live row, when a row is in no key, and when a row has no style family in pipeline/audio/style.json. At run time the Feedback Adapter prints `AUDIO: event key=<key> sound=<id> t=<s>` for each key it handles; `--log` fails a key that fired with sound=none, an unknown key or a sound that is not mapped to it. `silent` needs a reason and is only for things that never make a noise in the shipped game. `pending` is only for a feature that is not approved yet (EXPERIMENT, PROPOSED, DEFERRED in docs/feature-manifest.json); it fails the moment the feature is approved.

sources.event: docs/feature-manifest.json `events`, the GDD 1.3 section 4 required event vocabulary, and the event list in pipeline/unreal/gameplay-code.md
sources.state: GDD 1.3 section 3A umbrella state table and section 8 encounter state table
sources.attack: GDD 1.3 section 7 boss pattern table (the row name before any bracket)
sources.ui: pipeline/ui/menus.md menu actions: focus, Confirm, Back, Quit
sources.signal: pipeline/ui/signals.json: each sound_id must be a live row (ui_check.py signals checks the rest)

event:UmbrellaConfigChanged.why: the state key below picks one

event:LiftAvailabilityChanged.why: the canopy flutter starts and stops with lift

event:PlayerHealthChanged.why: down: hurt, up: heal; a wear-stage change adds the tear, critical starts the loops

event:ProjectileContact.why: contact with a target, the shield, or a bound / lifetime end

event:CatchAttempt.silent: an internal check; its outcome (CatchSucceeded or CatchFailed) carries the sound

event:CatchFailed.why: a failed catch is a hit taken

event:TestPresetLoaded.silent: dev-only workbench (QA-BASE); never in the shipped build

event:AnimationCue.silent: a presenter cue; each sound hangs on the semantic event or state the cue shows, so a frame never plays a sound by itself (gameplay-code.md: no gameplay from flipbook events)

event:BackgroundLooped.silent: a visual layer wrap; BelfryAmbience and WindBed are the backdrop's sound and loop on their own

state:OPEN_LEFT.why: same rib-lock motion; a side variant only if UMB-03 is approved

state:OPEN_RIGHT.why: same rib-lock motion; a side variant only if UMB-03 is approved

state:INVERTED.why: wind inversion is an EXPERIMENT; its sound row comes with its approval

attack:steam-vent.why: an EXPERIMENT; its windup (a Telegraph row with a fallback file) and loop come with its approval

attack:complex-pattern.silent: combines attacks that each have their own sounds

feature:WIND-02.why: wind wear is the same tear

feature:ANIM-01.silent: animation shows states; their sounds hang on the state keys

feature:QA-BASE.silent: dev-only workbench; never in the shipped build

feature:VFX-01.why: the pressure motif is the music layers and the phase chime

feature:CAM-02.silent: camera motion; no object makes a noise

feature:MOVE-02.why: a faster fall is the same air rush, louder

feature:MOVE-03.why: EXPERIMENT; a dash sound comes with its approval

extra:phase-change.why: GDD 1.3 section 8 phases: the chime (if presets are used) and the layer that joins

extra:charge-shot.why: the PC shooting open note (GDD 1.3 section 5); P2 until it is picked

extra:umbrella-repair.why: the repair open note; P2 until it is picked
